title: 第十五章　开幕
content_zh:
阳光带着波浪式的光纹射了进来，在屋内照出一个萨尔的身影，接着就是艾勒维格，最后就是，什么也没有，空空的一个屋子，里面什么也没有。

    “这是……”回头的艾勒维格，瞪直了双眼，可是今天的脑子比从前迟钝了许多，就像短路了一般，思索不起来。

    “幻幕！”萨尔轻叹一声。

    “幻幕？什么东西？”艾勒维格自然不明白，这种血族中的称呼。

    “虚幕的一种，可以造出一些影像，迷惑别人，只有强大的存在才能造出这种幻幕。”萨尔说着，竟然就如此走进了阳光中，虽然他不想总是与阳光这么亲密接触，可是现在别无选择。

    “也只有强大的存在才能不受影响。”艾勒维格从一开始就知道萨尔的强大，现在再次肯定，“不过，你现在要去哪里？”

    “找人。”萨尔回答着，直步向前，一直走到了城的中央。

    “找人？这里？”艾勒维格也来到了萨尔的身旁，可是目及之处除了房屋还是房屋，要不就是沙子。

    “嗯。”萨尔站定，冲着那个城门的方向，喊道，“如果你觉得这样很好玩，那么我可以陪你玩下去，不过over的代价你最好考虑清楚。”

    “萨尔先生，什么时候您这么冲动了？”结果一串柔美的笑声从城门处传来，“只不过是个游戏，用不着发这么大的火吧！”

    “游戏？”萨尔面色一冷，“如果艾妮尔出什么事，我会让这个游戏玩到这里只成沙粒。”

    “哦？您这么有信心？”她笑了，暧昧的笑意入目三分，只是对于萨尔来说，这些也就跟刚才的幻幕一样，只是虚无飘渺的存在，没有任何的吸引力。

    “我想你们看重的应该是我的实力，而不是什么信心。”萨尔冷笑一声，一眨眼已经站到爱夏的面前，近在鼻尖的距离，让双方可以清楚的感觉到对方的冰冷。

    “不愧是萨尔先生，真是聪明！”爱夏说着，干脆往萨尔的双唇亲了上去，萨尔一个瞬移避开，当爱夏再想回身，已经感觉到脖子上的锐利，“艾妮尔在哪里？”

    “萨尔先生好狠的心啊！明明昨天我们还无比的亲密，怎么不过一天时间，就如此对待我？”爱夏一点不也不紧张，还手抚上萨尔的手腕，轻轻的抚摸着，似乎完全不担心，那些锋利无比的指尖会划开自己的喉咙。

    “艾妮尔不是你可以随便乱动的人。”萨尔微微的皱眉，指尖已经刺进爱夏的脖子，受夏吃痛的轻唤一声，“啊！”

    “好了，这下你明白了吧！”突然从两人的背后传来一个陌生的男声，“男人的心可不都是花的。”

    “嗯，原来男人的心也有死的。”爱夏无奈一笑，想要离开萨尔的指尖，可是意识却完全不能左右自己的身体，怎么用力都迈不开双脚，此时她才知道危险，“萨尔先生你……”

    “艾妮尔呢？”萨尔不再看着爱夏，转而盯着那个新出来的男子，一样是贵族，不过对方的个子矮小了许多，看上去不过是个十二三岁的孩子，可是听他的口气，又不是这么回事，所以萨尔不需要对待孩子般对他。
content_en:
The sunlight came in with wavy light patterns, illuminating a silhouette of Thrall in the house, followed by Ellevig, and finally, nothing, an empty room with nothing in it.

    "This is..." Ellevig looked back, his eyes widened, but today his brain was much slower than before, as if there was a short circuit and he couldn't think.

    "Illusion screen!" Thrall sighed softly.

    "Illusion screen? What is it?" Ellevig naturally didn't understand this kind of name among the vampires.

    "A type of virtual screen that can create some images to confuse others. Only powerful beings can create this kind of illusion screen." Sal said, walking into the sunshine like this. Although he didn't want to be in such close contact with the sun all the time, he had no choice now.

    "Only powerful beings can remain unaffected." Ellevig knew Thrall's power from the beginning, and now he affirmed it again, "But where are you going now?"

    "Looking for someone." Thrall replied, walking straight forward until he reached the center of the city.

    "Looking for someone? Here?" Ellevig also came to Sal's side, but everywhere he saw there were only houses, or sand.

    "Well." Sal stood still and shouted in the direction of the city gate, "If you think this is fun, then I can play with you, but you'd better consider the cost of overcoming."

    "Mr. Sal, when did you become so impulsive?" A string of soft laughter came from the city gate, "It's just a game, there's no need to get so angry!"

    "Game?" Thrall's face turned cold. "If anything happens to Enel, I will make this game become nothing more than grains of sand."

    "Oh? Are you so confident?" She smiled, with an ambiguous smile that caught her eye. But for Sal, these were just like the illusion just now, they were just ethereal existences without any attraction.

    "I think what you value is my strength, not my confidence." Sal sneered, and in the blink of an eye he was standing in front of Ai Xia, so close to the tip of his nose that both parties could clearly feel the other's coldness.

    "As expected of Mr. Sal, you are so smart!" Ai Xia said and simply kissed Sal's lips. Sal teleported to avoid it. When Ai Xia wanted to turn around again, she could already feel the sharpness on her neck, "Where is Enel?"

    "Mr. Sal is so cruel! We were so close yesterday, why did you treat me like this in just one day?" Ai Xia was not nervous at all. She put her hand on Sal's wrist and stroked it gently, as if she was not worried at all that those sharp fingertips would slit her throat.

    "Enel is not someone you can mess around with." Sal frowned slightly, his fingertips had already pierced Aisha's neck, and Shouxia let out a soft cry of pain, "Ah!"

    "Okay, now you understand!" Suddenly a strange male voice came from behind the two of them, "Not all men have beautiful hearts."

    "Well, it turns out that men's hearts are also dead." Ai Xia smiled helplessly and wanted to leave Sal's fingertips, but her consciousness could not control her body at all, and she could not move her feet no matter how hard she tried. Only then did she realize the danger, "Mr. Sal, you..."

    "Where's Enel?" Sal no longer looked at Aisha, but instead stared at the new man who came out. He was also a noble, but he was much shorter. He looked like a child of twelve or thirteen years old, but from his tone, it was not like that, so Sal did not need to treat him like a child.
